about.bio: I design, code and publish my own apps end to end: interface, backend, signing, stores and deploy. I started on 2017-10-02 and today it is 17 apps with one shared backend and one design system.
about.exp.fullstack.desc: My own app ecosystem: vertical slice architecture, shared design system, backend split by domain, and releases on the App Store and Google Play.
about.exp.frontend.desc: React and TypeScript interfaces at scale, design tokens and a reusable component system.
about.exp.freelance.desc: Web and mobile apps for clients, from prototype to published listing.
